parsed.name: Zahner设备搜索器
parsed.description: 用于发现和选择Zahner仪器串口接口的软件组件（非物理设备）。它通过USB VID/PID与*IDN?查询识别已连接的Zahner设备，并返回命令口、数据口及相关串口信息，便于电化学仪器接入、通信配置和校准辅助。
parsed.description_en: A software component for discovering and selecting serial interfaces of Zahner instruments; it is not a physical device. It identifies connected Zahner devices using USB VID/PID information and *IDN? queries, then returns command, data, and related serial-port information to support instrument connection, communication setup, and calibration assistance.

actions.description: 扫描计算机上的串口，并通过*IDN?命令搜索已连接设备。
actions.description_en: Scan serial ports on the computer and search for connected devices using the *IDN? command.

actions.description: 结合Zahner的USB VID/PID和*IDN?查询搜索已连接的Zahner设备。
actions.description_en: Search for connected Zahner devices using Zahner USB VID/PID information together with *IDN? queries.

actions.description: 按Zahner的USB VID/PID枚举并筛选对应的串口接口。
actions.description_en: Enumerate and filter serial interfaces by Zahner USB VID/PID.

actions.description: 对指定或全部串口发送*IDN?，根据响应识别设备。
actions.description_en: Send *IDN? to specified or all serial ports and identify devices from their responses.

actions.description: 从已发现设备中按序列号选择设备；未指定时选择第一个。
actions.description_en: Select a discovered device by serial number; if none is given, select the first one.

actions.description: 获取所选设备的命令串口名称。
actions.description_en: Get the command serial interface name of the selected device.

actions.description: 获取所选设备的数据串口名称。
actions.description_en: Get the data serial interface name of the selected device.

actions.description: 获取连接校准用万用表的串口名称。
actions.description_en: Get the serial port name connected to the calibration multimeter.
